scope_note: Selected target is Appendix C.1 evaluation-binding-to-t-SDH reduction, not polynomial binding or the whole security theorem. Same commitment and index, two distinct field responses, both accepted evaluation witnesses; setup samples a private nonzero trapdoor and exposes its power SRS. The paper uses a symmetric pairing, PPT/static algorithms and equal success probability; the formal root uses two source groups, explicit pairing/nonidentity assumptions and a one-sided concrete probability inequality for this adversary/reduction. No asymptotic efficiency theorem or reference label follows from this binding.
